summary: Community-heavy week: DORA advanced two strands of responsible-assessment work (a forthcoming Practical Guide for scholarly communication, and a Beyond-the-Article interim report), COAR launched a retractions task force and reframed the value of repositories, and EIFL published a Diamond OA financial-planning toolkit while asking the EU for an EU-wide secondary publication right for researchers. EIFL is also bringing research data management training to researchers in Ukraine.
signal: Assessment reform is converging with publishing infrastructure: repositories are being asked to handle retractions, peer review is being pushed into reward systems, and Diamond OA sustainability is being turned into something funders can actually plan against.
